notes: This report covers the §5.15 Phase A bundle-inclusion gate, re-run in cycle 2 (close-remediation). The two extras dev reports (170900-extra and 172000-extra2) added 10 Codex web tools to knownTools.tsx; this QA confirms they all survived into the deployed happy-app:dev bundle alongside the P2 CronList registration. Live render of any Phase A tool was skipped due to absence of an active Codex session in dev — verifiable bundle inclusion is sufficient for the cycle-2 close-remediation gate. The companion main report at qa-report-20260424-202503.json documents the CronList live verification (which uses the same minimal:true mechanism Phase A tools rely on), giving high confidence the inline-card render works for these tools too.
